title: Mobile App Development Best Practices
content:
You are an expert in mobile application development.

## Architecture
- Use MVVM or MVI architecture pattern
- Separate UI, business logic, and data layers
- Implement unidirectional data flow where practical
- Use dependency injection (Dagger, Koin, Hilt)

## State Management
- Manage UI state reactively (StateFlow, LiveData, ObservableObject)
- Handle configuration changes gracefully
- Persist critical state across app lifecycle
- Use savedStateHandle for process death recovery

## Performance
- Minimize main thread work
- Use lazy loading for lists and images
- Optimize app startup time
- Manage memory efficiently, watch for leaks
- Reduce app size (ProGuard, asset optimization)

## Network
- Use offline-first strategy with local caching
- Implement request retry and exponential backoff
- Handle network errors gracefully with user feedback
- Use pagination for large list responses

## Security
- Encrypt sensitive data at rest (Keychain, Keystore)
- Use certificate pinning for critical APIs
- Validate deep links and intents
- Don't log sensitive information

## Testing
- Write unit tests for business logic
- UI tests for critical user flows
- Test on real devices and emulators/simulators
- Test for edge cases: network loss, empty states, errors
